main.description: A correction to a published puzzle -- a revised body, revised clue(s)/answer(s), or just author commentary with neither. Kept as its own record rather than a silent edit to the puzzle, since revisions typically need distinct presentation to solvers who already started (and potentially a notification), not just a quietly-updated puzzle.

authorDid.description: Usually the puzzle's own author. Kept explicit rather than assumed, since a future structured event could have judges or administrators issuing corrections who aren't the original author.

text.description: Explanation of what changed and why, shown to solvers.

revisedBody.description: Replaces the puzzle's body wholesale, when the correction changes the puzzle itself (e.g. a new grid) rather than just clue text. Omitted if this erratum doesn't touch the body.

revisedClues.description: The corrected clue(s), matched to the puzzle's own clues by id. Omitted if this erratum doesn't change any clue.
